description: A minimalist landscape with flat, brown earth and tall purple mountains in the distance stretches over a plain white background. A large blue form in the foreground could denote a shaded blue hill.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
title: Untitled (Taos Landscape)
